descriptions.text: Gorgon Marital Aid. A favorite amongst intergalactic porn stars, this is a hardening and de-hardening tool. May only be used at a workbench. Assists in fusing joints or creating varying degrees of plasticity in otherwise rigid materials without affecting material strength.

beats.headline: Shaped like a spatula
beats.text: A mechanic's box gives Carl a tool shaped like a spatula. What the hell is this, he mutters, and pulls up its properties: a hardening and de-hardening tool for the workbench, for fusing joints or giving otherwise rigid materials varying degrees of plasticity without changing their strength. That seems pretty useful. He puts it in his inventory next to his Goo-Inator 3000.

beats.headline: Plungers for a mine
beats.text: For his first derailment Carl goes with a classic: landmines, tire-shaped sections of spike-covered contact mine, an oblong metal tube stuffed with hob-lobbers and one hobgoblin stick for good measure. The system labels it a Jelly Bomb and gives him no credit for inventing it. When a train presses a spike, the plunger smashes an impact-detonated hob-lobber and the whole mine shreds. The plunger idea came from the Cookbook. He built the plungers with the Gorgon Marital Aid, and they are untested, which makes setting them nerve-racking.
